title: Strategic Outcome Quilt: Mapping Initiatives to Company Outcomes with Escalation Ladders
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a durable mapping between company-level outcomes and all active initiatives across product, eng, design, and GTM. Deliver a playbook that prescribes: (1) how initiatives are scored against outcomes, (2) a lightweight escalation ladder for conflicts, and (3) a milestone lattice that surfaces critical cross-team dependencies for leadership reviews.
background: Previous OKR artifacts focused on initiative lists and ownership but lacked a repeatable scoring model and clear escalation path when capacity conflicts arise. This ticket synthesizes learnings from the Q4 alignment pilots and aims to reduce ambiguous ownership during quarter boundary changes.
goals: Establish a common scoring rubric to map initiatives to one or more company outcomes (impact, confidence, effort)
Publish an escalation ladder that routes conflicts through defined roles (PM guild -> Strategy Council -> CTO) with SLAs
Deliver a living milestone lattice dashboard that highlights top-10 cross-team critical paths for exec review
success_metrics: >=95% of active initiatives have a scored outcome mapping in the registry by due_date
Time-to-resolution for cross-team conflicts reduced from 12 days to <=4 days (measured over next cycle)
Exec alignment meeting frequency reduced by 30% for triage issues due to clearer lattice visualization

acceptance_criteria: Rubric published in Confluence and added as canonical reference
All pilot initiatives scored and recorded in the registry CSV with source links
Escalation ladder has named roles, SLAs, and example playbook entries
Prototype lattice dashboard can trace at least three dependency chains and export a PDF summary for exec review
decisions: Use a 3-axis scoring model (Impact / Confidence / Effort) instead of a single priority number to avoid rank compression
Keep scoring subjective but require a documented rationale for each score; quantitative gating only for >$500k commitment initiatives
Escalation ladder limited to three tiers to reduce churn: PM Guild -> Strategy Council -> Exec Triage (CTO/COO)
